name: Shared Bearings
behavior: E fires three locked-aim shots 0.12 s apart; total damage stays the same.

name: Shared Bearings · Last Roll Call
behavior: Ultimate refills ammo again halfway through its field; its base damage bonus falls from 35% to 25%.

name: Shared Bearings · Rally Field
behavior: Q follows you, with 25% less radius.

name: Heavy Rhythm
behavior: E adds a moving 80-base-health front wall; base brace reduction falls from 45% to 25%.

name: Heavy Rhythm · Foundry Overture
behavior: Ultimate vents eight short-range shots every two seconds after the first second; base fire-rate bonus falls from 70% to 40%.

name: Heavy Rhythm · Suppressing Cone
behavior: Q divides the same fourteen pellets into two narrow cones with a gap in front.

name: Reinforced Face
behavior: Charge leaves an 80-base-health wall for two seconds at departure.

name: Reinforced Face · The City Holds
behavior: Ultimate follows you and shields each entrant once for 90 base health instead of 120.

name: The Last Door · The City Holds
Reinforced Face · Protective Wall
behavior: Q splits its wall into two angled panels, each with half the original health and length.

name: Wide Ward
behavior: E chains heals and cleansing to three distinct allies, within 140 per hop, instead of every nearby ally.

name: Wide Ward · Names Returned
behavior: Ultimate trades 40 instant base healing for 24 plus three healing pulses of 6. Difficulty revival rules still apply.

name: Wide Ward · Healing Field
behavior: Q follows the most injured nearby ally, with 25% less radius.

name: Deep Binding
behavior: E splits its 65 base damage into 40 now and 25 at the same ground point after 0.75 s.

name: Deep Binding · Silent Twelfth
behavior: Ultimate replaces its large fixed pulse with three smaller orbiting centers, each dealing one third of the pulse damage.

name: Deep Binding · Binding Sigil
behavior: Q makes two separated smaller sigils, each dealing half damage.

name: Spare Motor
behavior: Barricade stores up to 120 absorbed damage; destruction or expiry releases 60% of it nearby.

name: Spare Motor · Impossible Machine
behavior: Siege follows at 160 pixels per second; base health falls from 200 to 160.

name: Spare Motor · Rivet Turret
behavior: Q makes two turrets with half health and damage each; the second prefers a farther target.

name: Long Veil
behavior: Step deals 60% damage now and 40% along its locked path after 0.45 s.

name: Long Veil · Unwritten Passage
behavior: Ultimate lasts 3.5 s with one fewer free step; empowered departures leave three damaging pulses.

name: Long Veil · Invisibility
behavior: Q leaves a 60-health projectile-damageable decoy that attracts aim; base veil duration falls from 6 s to 4 s.
